# ₹500 for the Week

<!-- STEP id="budget" -->
Meera has ₹500 for the week. Her list: snacks ₹150, a film ticket ₹200, a game top-up ₹150 and a birthday gift for her brother ₹250. The list adds up to ₹750.

<!-- STEP id="gap" -->
She cannot buy everything, so she must choose what to leave out.

Wherever she buys, in a shop or on an app, she is in a **market**: any place where things are bought and sold.

**Limited money and many wants force a choice.**
